interaction.timingLimitation: These are high-level automation call durations, not browser input-event timestamps. Calls were awaited serially, so starts were approximately one second apart after the first click; exact mouse-event gaps were not independently measured.

finalVisibleState.screenshotObservation: Dashboard navigation rail remained visible; main content consisted of loading skeleton placeholders.

assessment.interpretation: After 12 sequential navigation actions, the final URL was /dashboard but the visible page remained in its workspace-loading skeleton state through a screenshot and accessibility-state read. This is a user-visible loading stall observation. The test lacks browser input timestamps, request timing, a raw trace, and host pairing; it cannot establish how long the loading state persisted or whether the delay was in network, server, database, or client coordination. The roughly one-second awaited automation call durations also mean this was not a verified sub-500-ms input cadence.
